translation.title: Chemistry Atelier
translation.description: A visual workbench for inorganic chemistry: material composition, the periodic table, and orbital shapes.

hero.subtitle: From a glass of water to an alloy, from atomic orbitals to the whole periodic table. Ratios, structures, and periodicity become plates you can browse.

materialCards.title: Material Cards
materialCards.desc: Draw the elemental composition of common materials as a pie chart or a Voronoi lattice, and switch between mass and atomic ratios instantly.

periodicTable.title: Periodic Table
periodicTable.desc: A full 17-group layout, recolored by temperature, phase, electronegativity, and atomic radius, with search by Chinese name, symbol, or number.

science.title: From atoms to materials, chemistry connects the microscopic and the macroscopic
science.body: A formula is a recipe, a structural formula is its skeleton, and ratios and periodicity are the grammar that runs through both. Drawing those relationships turns abstract numbers into shapes you can compare, remember, and keep questioning.
science.quote: We do not see elements so much as the relationships between them.
science.caption: Benzene ring and p orbitals

translation.footer: Chemistry Atelier · read matter through plates
translation.footerNote: Data from public element property tables; charts are for learning and illustration.
